nvitk.gui.pipeline.data_presets
===============================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.pipeline.data_presets

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Pipeline filesystem presets for the Napari data browser (local mode).

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: NIFTI_SUFFIXES
   :value: ('.nii.gz', '.nii')


.. py:data:: QVTPY_PIPELINE_BUNDLE_DIRS
   :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('eicab', 'qvtpy')


.. py:data:: PESA_FAT_SUBJECT_GLOBS
   :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('PESA*',)


.. py:data:: _COHORT_WEEK_RE

.. py:class:: PipelinePresetSpec

   Registered pipeline with default data roots from its config module.


   .. py:attribute:: preset_id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: label
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: config_module
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: layout
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: subject_globs
      :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]


   .. py:attribute:: show_batch
      :type:  bool


   .. py:attribute:: default_batch
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: pesa_fat_layout
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



.. py:class:: PipelineRoots

   Resolved roots for browsing a pipeline on disk.


   .. py:attribute:: preset_id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: dicom_root
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: nifti_root
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: results_root
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: layout
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: batch
      :type:  str | None


   .. py:attribute:: subject_globs
      :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]


   .. py:attribute:: pesa_fat_layout
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



   .. py:method:: subject_dicom_dir(subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

      *subject*'s DICOM directory under this preset's DICOM root.



   .. py:method:: subject_nifti_dir(subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

      *subject*'s NIfTI directory under this preset's NIfTI root.



   .. py:method:: subject_results_base(subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

      Base results directory for *subject* (the batch subfolder for batch layouts).



   .. py:method:: _subject_base(root: pathlib.Path, subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

      *subject*'s directory under *root*, nested under the current batch for batch layouts.



.. py:class:: LocalAsset

   One openable file or DICOM directory for a subject.


   .. py:attribute:: kind
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: label
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: path
      :type:  pathlib.Path


.. py:data:: PRESET_REGISTRY
   :type:  tuple[PipelinePresetSpec, Ellipsis]

.. py:function:: list_pipeline_preset_ids() -> list[str]

   Ids of every registered pipeline data-browser preset, in registry order.


.. py:function:: get_pipeline_preset(preset_id: str) -> PipelinePresetSpec

   Look up the registered :class:`PipelinePresetSpec` for *preset_id*; raises ``KeyError``
   (listing known ids) if unregistered.


.. py:function:: _path_from_config(mod: Any, name: str) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Read a path-valued attribute *name* off a pipeline config module *mod*, or ``None`` if unset.


.. py:function:: _is_cohort_dir_name(name: str) -> bool

   Cohort folder under NIFTI/DICOM/RESULTS roots (not a PESA subject).


.. py:function:: list_local_cohorts(*, nifti_root: pathlib.Path | str, dicom_root=None, results_root=None) -> list[str]

   Discover cohort folders (e.g. ``202602_Week1``) at the roots of a PESA-Fat tree.


.. py:function:: _cohort_has_pesa_subjects(nifti_root: pathlib.Path, cohort: str) -> bool

   True if *cohort*'s NIfTI folder contains any PESA-Fat subject directories.


.. py:function:: resolve_pesa_fat_batch(*, nifti_root: pathlib.Path, dicom_root: pathlib.Path, results_root: pathlib.Path, batch: str | None) -> str | None

   Pick a cohort folder when batch is missing or points at a non-existent path.


.. py:function:: load_preset_roots(preset_id: str, *, dicom_root=None, nifti_root=None, results_root=None, batch=None) -> PipelineRoots

   Load default roots from a pipeline config, with optional overrides.


.. py:function:: _is_subject_dir_name(name: str) -> bool

   Exclude pipeline stage folders and hidden entries.


.. py:function:: _matches_subject_globs(name: str, globs: tuple[str, Ellipsis]) -> bool

   True if *name* looks like a real subject directory (not junk) and matches any of *globs*.


.. py:function:: _list_subject_dirs(root: pathlib.Path, globs: tuple[str, Ellipsis]) -> set[str]

   PESA* (etc.) folder names directly under *root*.


.. py:function:: _batch_bases(roots: PipelineRoots) -> tuple[pathlib.Path, pathlib.Path, pathlib.Path]

   ``(nifti, dicom, results)`` base directories, nested under the current batch for batch layouts.


.. py:function:: _subjects_from_results_tree(r_base: pathlib.Path, globs: tuple[str, Ellipsis]) -> set[str]

   Collect PESA* under ``<cohort>/res_*`` (skip ``per_subject`` leaves).


.. py:function:: list_local_subjects(roots: PipelineRoots, *, include_dicom=True, include_nifti=True, include_results=True) -> list[str]

   Discover subject folder names from enabled roots (independent of asset filters).


.. py:function:: _is_nifti_file(path: pathlib.Path) -> bool

   True if *path* has a ``.nii`` or ``.nii.gz`` extension.


.. py:function:: _discover_dicom_assets(subject_dir: pathlib.Path) -> list[LocalAsset]

   List DICOM assets under *subject_dir*: one per subdirectory (assumed one series each), or the
   directory itself if it directly contains files.


.. py:function:: _discover_nifti_assets(subject_dir: pathlib.Path, *, max_files: int = 200) -> list[LocalAsset]

   List every NIfTI file found anywhere under *subject_dir* (capped at *max_files*), labeled by
   their path relative to *subject_dir*.


.. py:function:: _discover_results_assets(roots: PipelineRoots, subject: str) -> list[LocalAsset]

   List *subject*'s pipeline output files under *roots* (batch-layout ``res_*`` stage
   subdirectories, including a ``per_subject`` fallback, or the flat results tree otherwise).


.. py:function:: list_local_assets(roots: PipelineRoots, subject: str, *, include_dicom=True, include_nifti=True, include_results=True) -> list[LocalAsset]

   List openable DICOM series, NIfTI files, and result masks for *subject*.
